Laboratory Services

Material testing and characterization with in-house equipment and access to specialized scientific infrastructure

Xenon Weathering Chamber

Accelerated Weathering Testing with Xenon Lamp

Evaluation of the behavior of materials, labels, coatings, plastics and components exposed to simulated solar radiation via Xenon arc chamber.

Evaluation conditions

  • UV–Visible radiation
  • Black panel temperature
  • Relative humidity
  • Condensation cycles
  • Rain simulation

Reference Standards

ASTM G155, ASTM D4329, ASTM D2565, ASTM D4587, ASTM D2244, ASTM E1164, AATCC 16, ISO 4892-2, ISO 7724, ISO 17228, ISO 105-B02, ISO 105-B04, SAE J2527 and SAE J2412.

Service oriented toward the evaluation of performance and durability of materials and components under controlled accelerated exposure conditions, in accordance with applicable methodologies and technical references.

Climatic Chamber

HD-E702 Climatic Chamber

Simulates controlled temperature and humidity conditions to evaluate the reliability and durability of electronic, automotive, plastic, and metal products under extreme environments.

Waterproof Testing

IPX8 Water Immersion Tank

Evaluates water resistance of electronic products, luminaires, and electrical components through continuous immersion under controlled hydrostatic pressure, simulating depths up to 50 meters.

Salt Spray Corrosion

S-10 Salt Spray Chamber

Applies continuous salt fog to evaluate corrosion resistance of materials, coatings, and metal components. Simulates aggressive marine and saline environments.

Request a Quote
Thermal Aging

TCC-1000 Thermal Aging Chamber

Applies temperature cycling to evaluate the stability of materials, cables and components under repeated thermal changes. Simulates storage, transport and operation under variable temperature conditions.

Laboratory Capabilities

Accelerated Weathering

Accelerated aging simulation using Xenon radiation. Durability evaluation of materials and coatings per applicable ASTM, ISO and AATCC standards.

  • Chamber temperature range: RT to 80 °C
  • Relative humidity range: 30 % to 98 % RH
  • Blackboard temperature: 0 °C to 80 °C
  • Spectral wavelength: 290–800 nm
  • Adjustable rain/spray function

Colorimetry & Gloss

Objective measurement and quantification of color and surface gloss. Evaluation of changes caused by environmental exposure and aging.

Chemical Composition Analysis of Materials

Spectroscopic analysis of materials. Identification and characterization of molecular composition.

  • Raman spectroscopy
  • IR spectroscopy
  • Mass spectrometry
  • Thermogravimetry
  • Gas chromatography

Material Evaluation

Comprehensive characterization of physical, mechanical and chemical properties of industrial and research materials.

  • Shore hardness
  • Tensile testing
  • Infrared analysis
  • Tensile strength, rupture and deformation resistance
  • Measurement of galvanized thicknesses and coatings on ferrous and non-ferrous elements

Specialized Measurement

Specialized measurement testing adapted to the specific technical requirements of each client.

Specialized Technical Support

Expert technical advisory, results interpretation, and support for research and development projects.

Complementary Capabilities

Through our Technical Partners, we extend our specialized service offering:

Environmental Testing

Temperature, salt spray, corrosion, and accelerated UV aging.

Mechanical Characterization

Tensile strength, rupture and deformation, Shore hardness, measurement of galvanized thicknesses and corrosion analysis.

Thermal Analysis

Thermogravimetry (TGA) and Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC).

Mass Spectrometry, IR & Raman Spectroscopy

Mass spectrometric analysis, FTIR, Raman spectroscopy, and gas chromatography.

Automotive supply chain and beyond

We serve Tier 1, 2, 3 & 4 companies and Technology Research & Development Centers

If your organization requires material testing backed by international standards, KAIBELAB has the capacity and technical rigor to deliver.
